references.text: The warning that the remaining peoples will become a snare to the Israelites if they are not driven out of the land.
Exhortation not to make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, as they will become a snare.
God's people are warned against letting the nations become a snare to them.
Joshua's warning that the remaining peoples will become a snare, a whip and thorns in their eyes and sides.
Fulfillment of the warning: the peoples who were not driven out became thorns in Israel's sides.
Description of how Israel did not destroy the nations, and these became a snare to them.
Thorns are used as an image of pain and trouble, similar to the imagery in the Numbers verse.
The prophecy that neighboring peoples will no longer be a stinging thorn or painful thorn for Israel.
